message.content:
Here are some of the major airports in the United States, ranked by passenger traffic and overall importance:

| Airport | City / State | IATA Code | Notable Features |
|---------|--------------|-----------|------------------|
| Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL) | Atlanta, GA | ATL | Largest airport in the world by passenger traffic; major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) | Los Angeles, CA | LAX | Major gateway to Asia, Latin America, and the Pacific; hub for American Airlines and United. |
| Chicago O’Hare International Airport (ORD) | Chicago, IL | ORD | One of the busiest airports in the U.S.; hub for United and American. |
| Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW) | Dallas/Fort Worth, TX | DFW | Hub for American Airlines; one of the largest airports by land area. |
| Denver International Airport (DEN) | Denver, CO | DEN | Largest airport in the U.S. by land area; hub for United and Southwest. |
| John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK) | New York City, NY | JFK | Major international gateway; hub for Delta and American. |
| San Francisco International Airport (SFO) | San Francisco, CA | SFO | Key hub for United and a major gateway to Asia. |
| Seattle–Tacoma International Airport (SEA) | Seattle, WA | SEA | Hub for Alaska Airlines and a major gateway to the Pacific Northwest. |
| Miami International Airport (MIA) | Miami, FL | MIA | Major hub for American Airlines; key gateway to Latin America. |
| Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX) | Phoenix, AZ | PHX | Hub for American and Southwest; one of the busiest airports in the Southwest. |
| Orlando International Airport (MCO) | Orlando, FL | MCO | Major hub for Southwest; key gateway to theme parks and tourism. |
| Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR) | Newark, NJ | EWR | Hub for United; major gateway to the Northeast. |
| Charlotte Douglas International Airport (CLT) | Charlotte, NC | CLT | Hub for American Airlines; one of the fastest-growing airports. |
| Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County Airport (DTW) | Detroit, MI | DTW | Hub for Delta; major cargo and passenger hub. |

These airports serve as major hubs for domestic and international flights, handle millions of passengers annually, and are critical nodes in the U.S. aviation network.
